name: social_inbound_reply_x_linkedin
prompt:
Run the inbound notifications responder for both X/Twitter and LinkedIn:
~/Development/Aarambh/hermes-agent/.venv/bin/python ~/.hermes/scripts/auto_reply_inbound.py

Check the script output for: replied_to, reply_text, status. If the script failed, report the error.

IMPORTANT: Apply fake job filtering. Skip posts that:
- Ask for money/upfront payment
- Have vague company names or no company at all
- Look like recruitment agency spam with generic descriptions
- Ask for sensitive personal info (PAN, Aadhaar, bank details) upfront
- Promise unrealistically high salaries for the role/location
- Use phrases like "work from home opportunity", "earn thousands daily", "no experience needed"
- Are from accounts with no profile picture, very few followers, and only job postings
- Have broken links or suspicious shortened URLs
